verdict.rationale: Fenwick's offices page lists only seven US offices and explicitly no international ones, so the firm does not state its own offices or qualified practices in multiple countries. The trademark practice's claim to register marks in over 180 jurisdictions is an adjacent filing capability, not evidence of qualified multi-country practice, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm states its own offices or qualified practices in multiple countries, so expansion does not immediately mean a second firm
